thread:
Sophia: Quick heads-up — planning schema migration for users.addresses tonight 02:00 UTC. Plan: 1) add nullable column `shipping_address` (no downtime) 2) run throttled backfill job 3) enable split-write (app writes to both cols) for ~10m and monitor 4) cut reads to new column, then cleanup. Estimated total ~45m. Need deploy owner, smoke run, rollback owner, and DB snapshot confirmation. Any blockers?

Ryan: I can own deploy + rollback readiness. Will be on call at that time. @Marta can you confirm snapshot + restore window? :+1:

Marta: Snapshot taken -> `snapshot-users-218765` at 2026-03-17T01:30:00Z. Retention 24h. Restore test passed on staging.

Jake: I’ll take smoke tests. Planning a quick checklist: create test user, confirm write/read from both cols, run timeline queries, check latency spikes. I have a smoke script — will run at each major step.

Priya: Are we good on dual/split-write window length? Traffic avg 2k rps. Recommend enabling feature flag in small cohorts first, then global for 10m. If we see err rates >0.5% or p95 latency +200ms, we rollback.

Sophia: Agreed. Proposed sequence with times (UTC):
- 01:50 dry-run on staging (confirm backfill params)
- 02:00 add nullable col (DDL online)
- 02:05 start backfill (throttle)
- 02:25 enable split-write flag (10m cohort)
- 02:35 cut read to new col (smoke + monitoring)
- 02:40 cleanup + schedule schema drop later

Ryan: What backfill batch size + pacing? I want to avoid IO spikes.

Sophia: batch_size=1000 rows, pause=200ms between batches. Backfill job reports progress to /internal/backfills. Estimated run 15-25m on prod.

Jake: Smoke script snippet (will run after step 3 and after read-cut):
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -X POST http://feature-qa/create_test_user -d '{"user_id":"smoke-1","addr":"1 Test St"}'
# verify both writes present
curl http://api.internal/users/smoke-1 | jq '.shipping_address'
# run timeline query
psql -c "select count(1) from users where shipping_address is not null;"
```

Priya: Rollback plan: 1) flip off split-write flag so app writes only to old column 2) if backfill partial, re-run idempotent backfill later (we track by user_updated_at) 3) if severe, restore snapshot (Marta has snapshot). Ryan to execute restore if needed. Make sure feature flag toggle is quick (~30s).

Ryan: I’ll own snapshot restore if we need it. Confirmed I have perms and a playbook for restore (steps + contact list).

Marta: DB ops note: concurrent index builds are disabled for this migration. If we need an index change later, we schedule separately. Also turned on low-priority GC.

Sophia: Monitoring hooks: Grafana dashboard `users-migration` will track backfill throughput, p95, error-rate, DB write IOPS. Pager thresholds: error-rate >0.5% or p95 +200ms -> paged to oncall.

Jake: I'll post smoke results in this thread as I run them. Also will add a short TL;DR after each major step with ✅ or ⚠️.

deploy-bot: Migration job scheduled by Sophia for 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z. job-id `mig-218765-usraddr`. Status: scheduled.

Priya: Small ask — can we limit split-write to 10% of traffic for initial 3m, then 100% if metrics clean? Safer for topologies with cached writes.

Sophia: yes — will configure rollout: 10% -> 100% after 3m if no alerts.

Ryan: quick preflight: run schema-check query at 01:45 to confirm no conflicting col names + verify app migrations are deployed to canary.

Marta: done — preflight script ran on prod mirror, no conflicts.

Sophia: OK locking this plan. Owners: Deploy/Rollback = Ryan, Smoke = Jake, DB snapshot/ops = Marta, Rollout tuning = Priya, Migration lead = Sophia. Will proceed unless someone objects in next 30m.

Jake: no objections. I’ll be in channel and start smoke at 02:06.

Ryan: 👍 ready.

Priya: 👍 will watch metrics.

Marta: 👍 standing by for restore if needed.

Sophia: Thanks folks — I’ll post a quick post-mortem + follow-up cleanup schedule after completion.
